=== d01-unsigned
--- manifest
@fixtures/unsigned.yaml
--- response discover.json
{"referrers":[]}
--- responses
oras|resolve registry.example.test/charts/demo:1.2.3|0|sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab|
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.sig|1||Error response from registry: failed to find chart.sig: not found
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.att|1||Error response from registry: failed to find chart.att: not found
oras|discover --depth 1 --format json registry.example.test/charts/demo@sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab|0|discover.json|
--- results
ocirepository.yaml	registry.example.test/charts/demo:1.2.3	sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab	unsigned	no signing-related or unknown material discovered
--- findings
--- errors
=== d02-digest-pin
--- manifest
kind: OCIRepository
metadata:
  name: demo
  annotations:
    home-ops/chart-verify-exclusion-reason: unsigned
spec:
  url: oci://registry.example.test/charts/demo
  ref:
    digest: sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab
--- response discover.json
{"referrers":[]}
--- responses
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.sig|1||Error response from registry: failed to find chart.sig: not found
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.att|1||Error response from registry: failed to find chart.att: not found
oras|discover --depth 1 --format json registry.example.test/charts/demo@sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab|0|discover.json|
--- results
ocirepository.yaml	registry.example.test/charts/demo@sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab	sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab	unsigned	no signing-related or unknown material discovered
--- findings
--- errors
=== d03-legacy-signature
--- manifest
@fixtures/unsigned.yaml
--- response discover.json
{"referrers":[]}
--- responses
oras|resolve registry.example.test/charts/demo:1.2.3|0|sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab|
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.sig|0|{}|
oras|manifest fetch --descriptor *.att|1||Error response from registry: failed to find chart.att: not found
oras|discover --depth 1 --format json registry.example.test/charts/demo@sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab|0|discover.json|
--- results
ocirepository.yaml	registry.example.test/charts/demo:1.2.3	sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab	material-present	legacy-.sig
--- findings
- `registry.example.test/charts/demo:1.2.3` (`sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab`) carries signing-related or unknown material (legacy-.sig). Review it under ADR-0003 before changing trust or the exclusion reason (`ocirepository.yaml`).
--- errors

--- findings
